name: Apteva Apps
description: Curated registry of Apteva Apps. Each entry points at a manifest URL the platform can fetch + install.

apps.name: push
apps.description: Self-hostable Apple push notification relay for Apteva mobile clients. Registers iOS devices, encrypts APNs tokens at rest, delivers privacy-safe approval, alert, and report notifications, exposes delivery health in a dashboard panel, and configures a public relay hostname through Apteva-managed ingress, TLS, and optional Domains DNS.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: llm
apps.description: Generic OpenAI-compatible multimodal LLM gateway for Apteva-hosted apps and agents. Supports validated remote and base64 image inputs through Chat Completions, Responses, and MCP; provider-neutral image normalization; model modality enforcement; image-aware quota reservation; a native image test panel; bound OpenAI Codex subscription access with account-scoped catalog discovery and selectable advertised models; Anthropic, OpenCode Go, OpenAI, OpenRouter, and Fireworks providers; model and rate discovery; project and subject quotas and cost caps; scoped tokens; provider failover; and idempotent usage records. v0.5.6 adds LLM Gateway's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: design
apps.description: Agent-native parametric 2D/3D CAD for Apteva. Build safe LLM-generatable operation graphs as exact OpenCascade solids, inspect dimensions and topology, preview meshes, validate manufacturing constraints, export STEP, STL, 3MF, and GLB, and create traceable manufacturing packages.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: api
apps.description: Lightweight API gateway for Apteva SaaS projects. Owns public API hostnames, routes, API keys, CORS, request logs, incremental Function streaming, and safe authenticated AppBus invalidation feeds. v0.4.0 adds bounded in-list event matching, projections only from explicitly constrained data fields, and ordered per-projection coalescing so one stream can precisely invalidate several resources.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: saas
apps.description: Shared SaaS product orchestration, checkout, access, lifecycle, and usage for Apteva apps. New paid plans default to provider-independent automatic collection, saving a reusable method during hosted checkout and asking Billing to collect renewal invoices with durable idempotency; manual invoice links remain available explicitly. v0.8.2 adds SaaS's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: stocks
apps.description: Explore + screen the S&P 1500 (every Dividend Aristocrat & King) backed by Yahoo Finance. Min/max filters on market cap, dividend yield, payout ratio, P/E, and 5-year dividend growth; smart watchlists (rule-driven, manual, or hybrid) with live membership; per-stock quote, price chart, dividend history. Read-only: never places orders, holds no ledger. Free Yahoo public endpoints, no API key. v0.7.4 adds Stocks's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: taxes
apps.description: Business tax profiles, VAT/IVA/TVA estimates, corporate and income tax estimates, social contribution obligations, filing status, payment tracking, and links to billing and bills for source data and outbound tax payments. v1.0.4 adds Taxes's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: simple
apps.description: Minimal read-only UI for watching an Apteva agent — embed anywhere on the same host. Same-origin, path-mounted SPA; no sidecar.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: demo
apps.description: Client-facing demo runner. State board with live MCP-polled scenario cards, control rail with seed/reset recipes + scripted scenario triggers, chat dock for natural-language Q&A with the agent. Designed as a kiosk surface for client meetings.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: tasks
apps.description: Durable work, progress, schedules, occurrences, and opaque thread assignment for Apteva agents.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: fetch
apps.description: Controlled HTTP client for agents and operators. Agents get one fetch_request MCP tool with bounded requests, hardened redirects, SSRF protection, encrypted secrets, and redacted history. The responsive dashboard panel provides an API editor, saved requests, environments, and paginated execution history. v0.1.2 adds Fetch's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: todo
apps.description: Personal todo list — human-first counterpart to the agent mission board. Inbox / Today / Upcoming, lists (user-facing buckets), tags (cross-cutting context), priorities, due dates, snooze, and recurrence. Agent helps via natural-language quick-add, list, snooze, and complete tools. v0.4.10 adds Todo's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: notes
apps.description: Simple searchable notes for Apteva agents and human teams. Capture customer ideas, meeting notes, research snippets, decisions, and follow-ups with lightweight kinds, tags, source metadata, and a practical project page. v0.1.1 adds Notes's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: voice-notes
apps.description: Lightweight audio notes for Apteva projects. Record voice memos from the browser, store the raw audio in Storage, and optionally transcribe through a bound Deepgram connection. Standalone by default so simple recording does not require CRM, Tasks, or meeting workflows. v0.1.4 adds Voice Notes's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: books
apps.description: Structured long-form manuscript workspace. Create books, organize chapters and sections, write in markdown, keep notes, track revisions, and export manuscripts. v0.1.1 adds Books's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: events
apps.description: Create shows, collect performer applications, curate lineups, issue simple tickets, and run check-in. Built for small events and comedy-style performer intake: applications can be shortlisted, accepted, rejected, then scheduled into performance slots. Free/manual ticketing in v0.1; paid checkout can be delegated to an external URL. v0.1.3 adds Events's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: health
apps.description: Personal health log — weight, sleep, mood, heart rate, blood pressure, workouts. One flexible time-series table for any numeric metric plus a workouts list. Agent ingests natural-language one-liners ('weight 78.4', 'ran 5k 26min', 'bp 122/78') via health_log; the panel charts pinned kinds and lists recent sessions. v0.2 will add device sync (Apple Health, Oura, Garmin). v0.1.1 adds Health's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: pantry
apps.description: Food inventory for pantry, fridge, and freezer. Track products, barcode aliases, locations, quantities, expiry batches, low-stock thresholds, and shopping-list needs. Agents can add/use stock from natural-language lines or structured MCP tools, then answer questions like what expires this week and what should I buy. v0.3.1 adds Pantry's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: recipes
apps.description: Recipe library, nutrition estimates, meal planning, and pantry-aware shopping lists. Agents can create structured recipes, scale servings, estimate macros, plan meals, generate merged shopping lists, and suggest meals from available ingredients. v0.1.3 adds Recipes's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: status
apps.description: Per-agent status line. Agent writes 'what I'm on right now' via MCP; dashboard reads it live. Short-horizon counterpart to the long-lived directive. Includes a panel for operators to view, set, and clear the line, plus a /status skill teaching the cadence + tone protocol. v2.0.2 adds Status's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: channels
apps.description: Global agent-facing channel router with explicit channels, conversations, and messages tables; Dashboard Chat as a project channel, full-width panel, Inbox, ntfy.sh project channels, Telegram channels with webhook callbacks and inline buttons, optional inbound routing, generic app-bus events, and channel deletion from the panel. v0.6.1 adds Channels's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: crm
apps.description: Contacts, messaging inbox, lists, segments, and sales opportunities for Apteva agents and human teams, with project isolation and typed attributes.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: prospecting
apps.description: Standalone lead workspace with a full-width desktop working queue, left-side lead selector, right-side qualification workspace, and a unified add/import panel. Rejected leads stay hidden by default and can be permanently purged with explicit confirmation. Optional Web and CRM integrations remain available.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: computer
apps.description: Watch, steer, and replay hosted browser sessions. v0.7.61 adopts Computer's canonical icon and host-provided app identity across its chat cards.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: screenshots
apps.description: Capture browser screenshots from a URL, save them to storage, and browse them in a gallery. Built on the `computer` app for the browser session and `storage` for the bytes — this app owns no browser plumbing itself. Four MCP tools (capture / list / get / delete) plus a gallery panel and a chat-attachable screenshot-card the agent posts after a successful capture. Idempotency_key on capture deduplicates retries within a 10-minute window. v0.1 supports URL-driven capture only; attaching to a session the agent already opened lands when computer exposes session resume. v0.1.5 adds Screenshots's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: web
apps.description: Browser-native web intelligence with Google-default search, extract, crawl, map, research, response caching, rendered DOM parsing, and smart query-matched snapshot crops using Computer browser regions. v0.1.16 adds Web's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: signatures
apps.description: Send Storage PDFs for electronic signature with visual field placement: drag signature/date/text boxes onto rendered pages in the dashboard, and signers see those boxes overlaid on the document at their exact positions. Signatures can be typed or drawn; drawn marks are stamped into the completed PDF as images. Ordered signers and approvers, secure links, optional Messaging invitations, completed PDF and audit JSON back to Storage.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: storage
apps.description: File storage with virtual folders, signed URLs, dedup, resumable uploads, and a pluggable local or S3-compatible backend. v0.10.19 serves public and HMAC-signed downloads through a dedicated read-only anonymous route while keeping metadata, uploads, and mutations authenticated. v0.10.22 adds Storage's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: tables
apps.description: Typed-row database for Apteva agents and human teams. The row-shaped sibling to storage: define typed tables (text, number, bool, datetime, json, file_id), insert rows with strict validation, query with typed predicates, paginate. Read-only SELECT escape hatch with {table_name} placeholders for aggregations the named tools can't express. Project-scoped by default; opt-in global tables for shared lookup data. v0.1.13 adds changed fields and the complete current row to single-row update events for immediate event filtering.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: jobs
apps.description: Scheduled-job runner for one-time, interval, cron, and deterministic randomized daily-window work. Dispatches platform-authorized sibling app tools, external HTTP targets, or agent events with bounded concurrency, reclaimable leases, retries, occurrence-specific idempotency, execution metadata, previews, and retained run history.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: functions
apps.description: Lambda-style serverless functions in node or Go. Each function is an immutable, built version served by a pool of warm worker processes — the runtime boots once and serves invocations over a socketpair, no per-request spawn. Handlers reach other Apteva apps via context.call. Deploy-time build (npm install / go build), immutable versions with rollback, auto-routed HTTP at /fn/<name>, and optional public Function URLs at /url/<name>/<token>. v1.7.0 adds incremental HTTP response streaming and Server-Sent Events for both Node and Go functions while keeping functions_invoke unary.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: workflows
apps.description: Deterministic, on-demand pipelines. A workflow is a YAML/JSON graph of typed steps (http, function, app, integration, emit, branch) with goto-style branching and per-step retry. Triggered by HTTP, manual invocation, or another app's events (the sidecar opens one multiplexed SSE subscription per (source, project) lane); integration steps reach any in-project connection (Pushover, Slack, Resend, ...) by id without operator pre-binding. Per-step audit log so every run is inspectable, retryable, replayable. Strict separation from agents: workflows never call LLMs — if a step needs judgment it sends an event to an agent and the workflow ends. v0.4.9 adds strict pre-run event predicates plus short-circuit and/or conditions for event filters and branches.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: code
apps.description: Repositories — named, framework-tagged code workspaces scoped under Apteva projects. First-class editing tools modelled on Claude Code: partial reads with line numbers, exact-match string edits with uniqueness checks, atomic multi-edit, repo-wide grep + glob, ZIP import for repository initialization or overlay updates, editor-style SVG source-tree icons, and native repo issues for bugs, feature requests, tasks, comments, and code links. v0.5.18 makes coding tools more agent-efficient with compact grep modes, smaller paged reads, file outlines/excerpts, and dry-run unified patch application for large edits. v0.5.17 unifies project navigation with a single top tab bar and renames the global code view to Repositories. v0.5.16 gives the project-wide Issues inbox the full panel width and makes issue titles the primary row text with repo metadata below. v0.5.15 adds a project-wide Issues inbox in the UI so operators can scan and create issues across all repositories without selecting a repo first. v0.5.14 adds project-wide issue search for agents, defaults the issue UI to all states, and batches field edits in the edit modal. v0.5.13 moves issue metadata editing into a modal and keeps the issue detail page focused on title, body, links, and comments. v0.5.12 simplifies the issue UI with quieter issue rows, fewer visible filters, and compact metadata chips in the detail sidebar. v0.5.11 separates issue lifecycle state from workflow status: state=open|closed, reason=completed|not_planned, and status for board workflow such as todo, in_progress, blocked, or done. v0.5.10 promotes Code and Issues to top-level repository tabs, with the file tree scoped to the Code tab like a GitHub-style repo view. v0.5.25 adds Apteva Code's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: simulator
apps.description: iOS and Android simulators on demand. Boot a device, build a repo's source into an APK/.app, install + launch on a headless emulator or Simulator, stream the screen to the browser, and relay touch + key input. Called by Apteva Code on Run for mobile repos; usable standalone for any flow that produces a mobile artifact. v0.1.23 reconnects live view after transient proxy or sidecar interruptions instead of leaving the panel permanently on Stream closed. v0.1.24 adds Apteva Simulator's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: media
apps.description: Catalog + derivations + renders + transcripts + auto-descriptions for audio/video/image files in storage. Pluggable render backend: ffmpeg by default, Cloudinary when bound (offload trim/resize/transcode/crop/extract_frame). Subscribes to storage events for instant indexing on upload + cascade cleanup on delete; falls back to a 30s safety-net poll. Smart video thumbnails skip black/fade openings.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: podcast
apps.description: Podcast hosting and RSS feed management for Apteva projects. Create shows and episodes, attach Storage-hosted audio, probe durations through Media, publish valid RSS/iTunes XML feeds, track downloads, and expose custom feed domains through platform ingress with optional DNS writes via the Domains app. v0.1.11 adds Podcast's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: embed
apps.description: Create shareable viewer links and oEmbed-compatible responses for storage-backed files and media. Embed keeps publishing concerns out of storage: storage owns bytes and signed URLs; media can enrich thumbnails and dimensions; Embed owns the public viewer, iframe HTML, and oEmbed JSON. v0.1.4 adds Embed's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: media-downloader
apps.description: yt-dlp-backed media discovery and downloads for public and authenticated sources, including private, age-restricted, and member-only YouTube, Patreon, or Instagram media through encrypted Netscape cookie profiles. Includes no-key YouTube discovery and responsive panel search results. v0.2.15 adds first-class authenticated Instagram Post, Reel, and IGTV profiles.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: media-studio
apps.description: Generate or edit images, video, audio, music, and talking-head avatar videos via compatible providers. v0.10.57 adds provider-neutral identity, scene, and general reference groups across Venice reference-to-video models. It maps Kling references to structured identity elements, preserves ordered flat references for Grok, Wan, HappyHorse, Gemini Omni, PixVerse, and future flat-reference models, applies family-specific limits and identity prompt tokens, preserves input image MIME types, and exposes live video resolution controls in the UI. v0.10.56 merges owned Fish Audio voices with its popular public TTS catalog, deduplicates model IDs, and excludes non-TTS entries. v0.10.55 restricts the voice picker to the provider selected by the active TTS model, preventing cross-provider voices from appearing. v0.10.54 adds a provider-grouped voice picker, automatically routes generation through the selected voice provider, and moves custom voice cloning and design into a responsive dialog. v0.10.53 publishes the provider-neutral reusable voice stack for ElevenLabs, Fish Audio, Cartesia, and MiniMax. v0.10.52 adds Cartesia and MiniMax TTS, catalogs, cloning, and MiniMax Voice Design. v0.10.51 adds a first-class generation-card for chat with responsive image previews, branded video and audio controls, prompt/model/provider/cost metadata, and live promotion from queued video or avatar jobs to completed media. Generation results now return a structured chat_component hint, backed by project-scoped single-generation and single-job APIs. v0.10.50 makes JPEG the default image format across UI and MCP requests and guarantees final JPEG files are strictly below 2,000,000 bytes. It preserves quality 90 when possible, selects the highest fitting quality down to 70, then progressively resizes only when compression alone cannot meet the limit. Provider mismatches are converted before thumbnails, cache, and Storage. v0.10.49 replaces browser-default audio and video controls with a reusable Media Studio player across galleries, details, and previews. It adds stable 16:10 video stages for mixed aspect ratios, generated thumbnail posters, play/pause and seeking, mute, fullscreen, exclusive playback, responsive mobile controls, and aligned card metadata. v0.10.48 adds Deepgram Aura as a generic text-to-speech provider, including provider-specific speak routing, curated Aura model choices, Deepgram output formats, binary response normalization, Storage saves, and multi-provider UI behavior. Aura voices are selected through the model picker; unsupported separate voice and cloning controls are hidden for Deepgram. v0.10.47 removes historical failed jobs from the active gallery feed and makes current UI errors dismissible, automatically expiring them after 12 seconds. Failed job records remain queryable explicitly for diagnostics. v0.10.46 uses live Venice model constraints to omit unsupported aspect_ratio fields from video generation and quote requests, fixing WAN image-to-video while preserving aspect controls for models that support them. v0.10.45 adds indexed newest-first cursor pagination to media_history and the gallery, returns next_cursor and has_more, makes since filtering functional, and loads generation history in responsive 24-item UI pages with deduplicated Load more results. v0.10.44 replaces the compressed inline composer with a focused responsive creation dialog: a large prompt editor, grouped model and output settings, cleaner reference inputs, a full-screen mobile sheet with sticky actions, keyboard focus containment, successful-submit closing, and automatic dialog opening from Use as reference. v0.10.43 fixes model-specific image options under multiple provider bindings, stale responses after tab switches, required image-to-video references in the UI and Venice backend, project-scoped Storage previews, upload MIME and size validation, per-kind durations, local-cache details, and responsive/accessibility behavior. v0.10.42 fixes project-scoped panel writes by including project_id in generation and avatar-creation proxy URLs, preventing immediate 404 responses before provider execution. v0.10.41 rebuilds the panel with React's production JSX runtime and adds a regression test that rejects development-only jsxDEV artifacts. v0.10.40 supports multiple bound audio providers, adds Fish Audio TTS and voice catalogs, and makes voice cloning provider-neutral across Fish Audio and ElevenLabs from uploaded audio, Storage references, URLs, data URLs, or base64. The UI exposes provider selection, generic voice cloning, Fish output format, and prosody speed. media_models exposes merged provider-prefixed image and audio model ids when multiple providers are bound. v0.10.39 filters unsupported ElevenLabs request-stitching fields for Eleven v3 and zero-retention requests while preserving text continuity where supported, and forwards current language-normalization voice options. v0.10.38 makes image output_format the final stored-file contract: JPEG requests convert mismatched PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF provider bytes before Storage and flatten transparency onto white; PNG requests are also re-encoded when needed, while mismatched WebP fails instead of storing mislabeled bytes. media_generate supports image / video / audio_tts / audio_sfx / music / avatar; media_estimate estimates generation cost; media_delete removes generations and linked files. Async video/avatar jobs queue and poll automatically. Optionally saves outputs to Storage. v0.10.59 adds Media Studio's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: persona-studio
apps.description: Virtual influencer and reusable persona workspace. Owns consistent identities, style profiles, Storage-backed references, reusable items/products/props/locations, voice and avatar identity, campaigns, generated assets, cache keys, and Composer handoffs while Media Studio remains the provider-neutral generator. v0.1.21 makes persona video generation strictly reference-to-video: it requires visual references, selects or validates only reference-to-video models, honors live model limits, prioritizes weighted faces and selected item images, previews the exact references sent, and uses Media Studio's generic source_images contract. v0.1.22 adds Persona Studio's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: composer
apps.description: Multi-clip video and audio composition with layered visuals, timed audio, soundtracks, text overlays, AI-generated sources, and local or remote ffmpeg rendering. The AI-native multi-track workspace provides draggable and resizable clips, snapping, zoom, undo/redo, split and duplicate commands, composited preview, visible visual/text/audio/silence/soundtrack lanes, PIP layout controls, responsive drawers, and keyboard shortcuts. Public installs use the stable V1 timeline/render surface while experimental Composer V2 remains gated for internal development. v0.6.3 adds deterministic typography with bundled Inter Regular, Medium, Semibold, and Bold plus Go Mono Regular and Bold, explicit family/weight resolution on local and remote renderers, and warnings for font substitutions or unsupported V1 spacing fields.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: calendar
apps.description: Self-contained calendar — multiple calendars per project, events with recurrence (rrule), holidays helper. Agents read + write via MCP tools; the panel renders day / week / month / year / agenda views with click-to-create and drag-to-move. Multi-day + all-day events render clearly across views: truly continuous spanning bars in month view (per-week overlay), a dedicated all-day strip above the week/day timed grid, and connected span bars in the larger year mini-calendars. v0.3.6 adds Calendar's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: bookings
apps.description: Calendly-style booking links for human and AI-agent meetings. Booking types define availability, duration, intake fields, routing target, and meeting location. Bookings reads free slots from Calendar, creates the booked Calendar event, optionally creates a Calls room, and can attach invitees and booking activity to CRM. v0.1.2 adds Bookings's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: trips
apps.description: Plan trips end-to-end: destinations, transport, accommodation, activities, packing list, budget. Calendar sync keeps scheduled trip, transport, stay, and activity events in step. Trip ideas can hold candidate destinations, stays, transport, and activities before dates are known; adding dates schedules them. Optional Duffel and Google Places integrations power search, global deal scans, airport autocomplete, and route/date heatmaps.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: social
apps.description: Schedule and publish posts to your social media accounts (X, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Pinterest, Threads). Connect accounts from inside the app — no separate integration setup. Posts can be triggered from the panel or by an agent via MCP tools. v0.14.80 adds Social's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: commons
apps.description: User-owned public social node for the open web. Commons hosts local profiles, posts, follows, blocks, ActivityPub/WebFinger endpoints, signed outbound federation delivery, server-native ingress exposure for public hostnames, and a dashboard panel for operating a federated identity from an Apteva-controlled domain. v0.1.2 adds Commons's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: messaging
apps.description: Send and receive messages across channels (email via SES, SMS+WhatsApp via Twilio). Tracks SES/SNS delivery events including delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, complaints, delays, rejects, and rendering failures; mirrors them into Apteva message events and the operator panel. Sender setup can be rechecked idempotently to refresh SES identity, DNS, inbound receiving, SNS notifications, and delivery event wiring.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: campaigns
apps.description: Bulk-send orchestrator for CRM audiences. Compose email, SMS, or WhatsApp campaigns against CRM lists or segments, materialize recipients, schedule batch sends through Jobs, deliver via Messaging, respect suppression, add email unsubscribe links, and track per-recipient campaign status. v0.2.14 adds Campaigns's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: whatsapp-web
apps.description: Linked-device WhatsApp provider for WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business app accounts. Pair with a QR code, send and receive text messages through WhatsApp Web, and expose provider-shaped tools for Messaging integration. This is not the official WhatsApp Business Platform API.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: email-checker
apps.description: Stateless email validation — no DB, every call resolves fresh. email_check returns RFC 5322 syntax, DNS MX records, and list-based classification (disposable provider, free provider, role account) with a combined valid verdict. email_check_smtp runs an EHLO + MAIL FROM <> + RCPT TO probe against the domain's MX, flagging informative=false for Google/Microsoft (which accept every RCPT) and for blocked or greylisted responses. Also exposes a REST mirror at /check?email=. v0.3.1 adds Email Checker's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: domains
apps.description: DNS + domain inventory and registrar workflows for Apteva projects. v0.5 adds exact record-ID edits and deletes, safe multi-record RRset handling, project-isolated connections, strict provider errors and Spaceship pagination, serialized DNS mutations, and expiring idempotent confirmation intents for paid registration. v0.5.1 adds Domains's adaptive themed icon. v0.5.2 supports multiple DNS and registrar provider bindings with explicit defaults and per-domain connection selection.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: deploy
apps.description: Build and release services, Android apps, and iOS apps from Code, local, or Git sources through local, capsule, Codemagic, and GitHub Actions backends. Deploy manages production and staging environments, domains, retained artifacts, supervised runtime recovery, mobile signing, TestFlight and Play testing, and provider-neutral App Store Connect and Google Play listing preparation. v0.24.8 resolves rejected App Store review items before idempotently resubmitting the existing review submission with its replacement build.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: channel-chat
apps.description: Chat bridge between the agent and the dashboard / external channels. Persists messages with monotonic ids for clean reconnect. Currently bundled with apteva-server as a built-in framework app; will be extracted to a standalone installable app in a future release.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: trading
apps.description: Trading desk for Apteva agents. Multi-portfolio, multi-asset (equity, crypto, polymarket). Each portfolio runs in paper mode (deterministic in-process engine) or live mode (orders route through a bound broker integration; v0.2 ships Binance only). Mandate, allowed asset classes, and daily-loss halt enforced server-side; halt cancels working broker orders upstream. Approval policy lives in the agent's directive, not the platform. v0.4.40 adds Trading's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: torrent
apps.description: BitTorrent client + indexer-search frontend. Search across configured Jackett / Prowlarr / RSS sources, add downloads by magnet or .torrent URL; on completion the resulting files are uploaded to the storage app and probed by media. Generic — ships with no indexers preconfigured; the user supplies sources and is responsible for what they download. v0.2.1 adds Torrent's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: dlna
apps.description: Publishes a UPnP/DLNA MediaServer on the LAN. Smart TVs, game consoles, Sonos, VLC, and other AV clients discover the server via SSDP and browse a virtual library backed by the storage app for bytes + folder structure, and the media app for duration / codec / resolution metadata. No transcoding in v0.1: clients that can't decode the source codec see the file in the listing but won't play it. v0.2.1 adds DLNA Server's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: backup
apps.description: Verified, optionally encrypted backups for Apteva platform databases and local Fleet tenants. v0.3.4 adds app-authorized streaming with separate snapshot and restore permissions, explicit restore confirmation, and no administrator-key fallback.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: live-link
apps.description: Publish an Apteva instance through an explicitly selected HTTPS tunnel: anonymous Cloudflare Quick, a stable hostname on your Cloudflare zone, ngrok, or a stable free zrok reserved name. v0.6.5 safely removes orphaned zrok shares only when they belong to this Live Link environment and exact reserved hostname, preserves the reserved name, uses the zrok v2 unshare contract, and reports the real provider error instead of a bare exit code.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: tunnel
apps.description: Self-hosted, multi-tenant HTTP tunnels under an operator-controlled domain. Tunnel publishes optional wildcard DNS through Domains, reserves stable per-project HTTPS hostnames, and carries requests over outbound encrypted WebSocket connections to local services. Includes a dashboard panel, MCP management tools, hashed one-time connector credentials, quotas, token rotation, concurrency limits, and batched usage accounting. Requires Apteva 0.29.2 or newer.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: billing
apps.description: Customers, local invoices, payments, refunds, reusable payment methods, issuer settings, and PDF/HTML invoice rendering. Billing owns processor execution and webhook reconciliation. v0.12.0 adds a durable, idempotent Stripe refund request ledger for partial and full refunds while verified processor webhooks remain authoritative for invoice balances.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: catalog
apps.description: Products, immutable prices, and reusable promotions: the source of truth for what the business sells. v0.3.0 extends the existing discount reservation model with basket lines, automatic promotions, market and customer eligibility, merchandise and shipping allocations, free shipping, and buy-X-get-Y benefits while remaining independent of Commerce.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: inventory
apps.description: Reusable stock ledger for Apteva apps. Tracks SKUs, locations, on-hand quantities, safety stock, reservations, transfers, adjustments, receipts, and an append-only movement audit trail. v0.2.0 enforces safety stock, adds configurable reservation TTLs, and expires abandoned reservations through a worker and event.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: entitlements
apps.description: Shared access-control and usage layer. Grants, revokes, checks, and meters access for SaaS plans, courses, memberships, digital downloads, paid content, manual grants, trials, promos, and usage quotas. v0.2.2 adds Entitlements's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: orders
apps.description: Generic fulfillment ledger for physical, hosting, SaaS, digital, and service products. v0.3.0 adds idempotent partial returns, explicit approval/transit/receipt transitions, exchange linkage, optional Inventory restock, Billing refund coordination, and refund status reconciliation without coupling Orders to Commerce.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: subscriptions
apps.description: Generic recurring-commerce lifecycle for SaaS, physical product subscriptions, memberships, and services. Owns recurrence, trial endings, active renewal scheduling, cycle creation, subscription status, usage, discounts, and prepared invoice lines. Emits one idempotent subscription.cycle_due event per due period so product apps can orchestrate fulfillment and collection. v0.7.1 adds Subscriptions's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: checkout
apps.description: Independent cart and checkout orchestration that turns customer intent into a durable Billing invoice. v0.3.0 adds validated Information, Shipping, and Payment transitions, buyer and shipping snapshots, one-time recovery tokens, durable bootstrap and restart tools, abandonment expiry, and retry-safe payment resumption.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: commerce
apps.description: Multi-store commerce orchestration for Apteva. Connects independent Catalog, Inventory, Checkout, Billing, Orders, and optional Content and Ads apps; includes provider-specific Printful, Printify, Prodigi, BigBuy, and CJ Dropshipping adapters. v0.8.7 preserves canonical Ads resource names when configuring and displaying Meta Pixels.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: creators
apps.description: Patreon-like memberships for creators and communities. Manage multiple creator spaces, paid membership periods, expiring member portals, gated posts and pictures, scheduled publishing, Billing payment lifecycle events, optional CRM synchronization, and supporter announcements through Messaging. v0.3.0 adds publishable ordered collections, many-to-many post organization, collection metadata and Storage-backed cover images, plus public and member collection views with locked paid previews. v0.3.2 restores picture uploads and cover validation against the current Storage API, including uploads through the HTTP app surface. v0.3.3 adds direct collection-cover upload, preview, replace, and remove controls in the Creators panel using the same private Storage upload flow as Social. v0.3.4 restores portable production installs by targeting the supported Go 1.25 baseline. v0.3.5 adds Creators's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: community
apps.description: Community and course storefront for Apteva. Supports branded multi-community portals, Auth-linked members, public course products, one-time and recurring access, inline Stripe checkout, public sample lessons, reusable instructor profiles, consent-aware product testimonials, custom domains, and complete course delivery. v0.12.3 fixes instructor profile listing on production single-connection databases.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: bills
apps.description: Vendors, bills, and outbound payments — the AP mirror of billing. Lifecycle (received → approved → scheduled → paid) plus disputed / void. Per-bill provider field stays local in v0.1.x; bank-rail providers (Mercury / Wise / Bill.com) land in v0.2. PDF voucher rendering for filing/audit. Drop a PDF on the bills tab and it's uploaded straight away — bind OpenCode Go (Kimi K2.6 default, vision-capable) in the Bindings tab and OCR auto-fills vendor + line items + dates + totals automatically (binding IS the on switch as of v0.1.5; no separate config flip required). Caller args always win. PDF rendering via embedded PDFium-WASM (no CGO, no system deps). Storage app is a declared dep so it auto-installs. v0.1.32 adds Bills's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: finance
apps.description: Unified personal-wealth tracker — cash, brokerage positions, P2P loans, crypto, real estate, vehicles, pensions, loans, all in one ledger. Three nouns model everything: accounts (a place that holds value), instruments (the thing held — AAPL, BTC, EUR, your house), holdings (account × instrument → quantity + cost basis). Money in signed integer minor units; avg-cost accounting with cost_basis_delta on every txn so realised P&L is one column sum. Convenience tools for buy/sell/dividend/interest/transfer/valuation. Reports: net worth (point or monthly series, by account/kind/currency), allocation, performance (realised + unrealised P&L), cashflow (income vs expense per period). Per-category monthly budgets with hierarchical rollup. CSV import. v0.1 is manual entry; v0.2 plugs in integrations (Trading 212 first, then Plaid / Mintos / Binance) via the platform integrations engine — manual and integrated rows are indistinguishable downstream. v0.1.16 adds Finance's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: mqtt
apps.description: Embedded MQTT 3.1.1/5.0 broker and LAN message bus for IoT devices. v0.3.0 adds explicit credential lifecycle tools, retained-message administration, authenticated client connect/disconnect events, a stable filtered device event, bounded packet/client/queue controls, stricter ACL and topic validation, durable traffic metrics, and an expanded operations dashboard. Home Assistant discovery remains built in.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: devices
apps.description: Provision and control Arduino, ESP8266/ESP32, Raspberry Pi, and other MQTT-capable hardware. Devices provides per-device credentials and exact-topic ACLs, native capability discovery, allowlisted GPIO operations, variables and firmware functions, live state and telemetry, correlated commands, setup examples, and a project dashboard. Requires MQTT 0.3.0 or newer.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: tapo
apps.description: Local-LAN control of TP-Link Tapo cameras. Pan/tilt/zoom, snapshots, browser live view, RTSP stream URLs, app-level camera pause, ONVIF motion/person events surfaced in the camera UI, privacy + LED + night-mode toggles, presets. Talks the camera's secure_passthrough and ONVIF interfaces directly with no cloud round-trips. Setup requires enabling Third-Party Compatibility in the Tapo app and using the dedicated Camera Account credentials. v0.3.9 adds Tapo Cameras's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: ffmpeg
apps.description: Stateless ffmpeg-as-a-service for sibling Apteva apps. Three sync MCP tools — ffmpeg_grab_frame, ffmpeg_probe, ffmpeg_version — that wrap the local ffmpeg/ffprobe binaries. tapo's snapshot_capture is the v0.1 use case: grab one frame from a camera's RTSP stream without forcing every camera-y app to bundle its own ffmpeg. No DB, no panel, no async tools — minimal shape. Requires ffmpeg + ffprobe on PATH; OnMount refuses to start with a clear 'install ffmpeg' error if either is missing. v0.1.2 adds FFmpeg's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: docs
apps.description: Craft project-isolated, client-facing PDFs and lead magnets from reusable Markdown templates. Includes a starter-driven editor with live previews, Go-template variables, A4/Letter/Legal output, tables and Storage-backed images, resource-scoped agent permissions, strict input and image safety limits, and a paginated render audit trail. Finished PDFs are stored as stable Storage files. v0.4.2 adds Documents's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: instances
apps.description: Compute-host inventory + lifecycle for Apteva. Manages the local Apteva machine and remote VPS instances under one MCP/REST surface so other apps (Live Link self-vps, Deploy SSHRuntime, Backup off-host, future Containers/Database/MQTT/game-server apps) bind a single "compute" dependency instead of each speaking VPS-provider APIs directly. The local machine is auto-seeded as instance id=0 and is always 'ready' — cannot be created or destroyed via the public API. Remote instances are provisioned via Hetzner Cloud. Per-instance Ed25519 SSH keypair seeded into the box via cloud-init authorized_keys; background readiness probe flips status='provisioning' → 'ready' once SSH accepts the key. MCP tools cover create/get/list/destroy/run/upload/download/wait/metrics so higher-level apps can transfer artifacts between local and remote hosts. Vitals (CPU / mem / disk / net / load / uptime) via gopsutil locally and a /proc-parsing bash script over SSH remotely, cached 5s per host. v0.4.21 adds Instances's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: compute
apps.description: Shared transient compute queue for Apteva apps. Apps submit short-lived resource-heavy jobs, and Compute serializes them across local or remote hosts with priority, ownership, timeout, cancellation, and run history. It is the resource scheduler layer between high-level apps such as Media/Composer and low-level host providers such as Instances. v0.1.1 adds Compute's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: containers
apps.description: Generic Docker workload runtime for Apteva. Runs arbitrary container images on local or remote Instances hosts with pull policies, bounded pre-start file and secret injection, named volumes, ports, health checks, logs, lifecycle actions, storage usage metrics, and built-in blueprints. v0.1.26 fixes blueprint pull and host overrides, preserves reused volumes during failed starts, redacts stored environment values, adds ownership-aware cleanup and payload limits, removes mutable root installer scripts, improves health and list performance, and adds a complete responsive deployment form. v0.1.27 adds Containers's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: hosting
apps.description: Managed container-backed hosting control plane for Apteva tenants, arbitrary Docker images, and starter WordPress hosting products. Hosting provisions containers, exposes default hostnames through platform ingress, tracks generic runtime usage for plan enforcement, orchestrates Catalog, Billing, Subscriptions, Orders, and Entitlements for paid/free hosting sale flows, and can optionally provision Auth org/user/client records for hosted admin panels. v1.10.0 keeps Hosting as the product orchestrator while wiring tenant add-ons into generic Subscriptions items/usage, optional LLM subject/token orchestration, llm.usage.recorded ingestion, included-usage tracking, and subscription-backed metered overage invoicing. v1.11.1 adds Hosting's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: fleet
apps.description: Control plane for a fleet of client Apteva instances. Spawns each tenant with its own data dir and port, supervised by Fleet; hosted tenants can run on the parent server or on VPS instances. Includes tenant_clone and tenant_migrate for local/remote host-to-host transfer, read-only cloning with consistent SQLite snapshots, cold moves with rollback, streamed local-to-hosted transfers for large full clones, provider hooks for Backup, admin-driven bootstrap, encrypted api_key keyring, server-native ingress/cert registration for tenant hostnames, delegated DNS/domain grants, generic provider grants for sharing parent integrations into tenants, generic tenant inventory/platform/app-MCP control tools, health polling, boot reconciliation, tenant updates, and support-login tools. v0.8.25 replaces the logistics-style icon with a control-plane topology representing one parent coordinating managed Apteva instances.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: robot
apps.description: Agent navigation eval sandbox. 2D grid worlds the agent perceives partially (radius=2 default) and moves through one cardinal cell at a time. Episodes terminate via the harness — success on goal-reach or timeout at max_steps; the agent has no quit tool. A* baseline computed at scenario load powers an optimality_ratio metric on every successful run. Five gameplay tools (observe / move / pick / drop / no-give-up) plus three control tools (list_scenarios / start_episode / episode_status). pick + drop are reserved in the contract for v0.2 items. Three starter scenarios: empty_room, corridor (S-shape), warehouse_01 (three shelves). v0.1.7 adds Robot's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: vpn
apps.description: Backend-agnostic VPN orchestrator. Provisions a VPN server on an Instances host (local id 0 or a Hetzner VPS), generates keys, uploads daemon config, brings the interface up, and polls peer statistics on a timer. v0.1 ships WireGuard with native client support on macOS, iOS, Windows, Android, and Linux — the .conf returned by vpn_peer_add imports unchanged into every platform's official WG app. The internal Backend interface accommodates OpenVPN / IKEv2 later without changes to the MCP tool surface; tool names are protocol-neutral (vpn_peer_add, not wg_peer_add). Peers are created and revoked exclusively via MCP tools; the panel is monitor-only. v0.1.1 adds VPN's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: certs
apps.description: TLS certificate issuance for Apteva projects via Let's Encrypt (or any RFC 8555 ACME directory). Two challenge types: DNS-01 routes TXT writes through the Domains app (no registrar credentials held here); HTTP-01 uses the webroot pattern (writes /.well-known/acme-challenge/<token> to a directory served by whatever reverse proxy is on :80 — Caddy, nginx, traefik). cert_issue accepts a per-request challenge_type override and remembers it for renewal. Async issuance, daily renewal worker, privileged cert_material tool gated to the server's TLS cache. v0.5.3 adds Certs's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: routes
apps.description: Hostname-based routing for Apteva — owns the table mapping public hostnames (blog.example.com) to local backend targets (http://127.0.0.1:7100). Apps register routes via routes_register; apteva-server reads the table and reverse-proxies inbound traffic. Optional: uninstall and the platform falls back to path-based routing. Works the same for cloud installs (browser → public IP → apteva-server) and tunnel installs (cloudflared etc). v0.5.2 adds Routes's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: cdn
apps.description: Public-facing edge for apps that emit URLs. Composes optional Domains-managed DNS with apteva-server native ingress/TLS into one capability: given an origin and a hostname, expose it publicly. Passive zones route directly to an origin URL or installed app. Active zones route traffic through CDN itself; for Storage, origin_auth=signed_url lets CDN serve private files on a public hostname by minting short Storage signed URLs server-side and streaming the bytes back. Consumers call cdn_url_for_app to mint URLs through CDN binding policy, while cdn_url_for remains available for explicit zone-id URL assembly. The deprecated Certs and Routes apps are no longer CDN dependencies. v0.2.3 adds CDN's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: redirects
apps.description: Branded short links and domain redirects. Each rule maps a (hostname, path) pair to an external URL and answers with a 301/302/307/308 + Location header. Think Bitly on your own domain, or EasyRedir for post-rebrand migrations. Uses server-native ingress to claim public hostnames so apteva-server reverse-proxies inbound traffic here, with TLS handled by platform ingress. Optionally composes with Domains to upsert an A or CNAME record pointing at the platform when the apex is managed there. Match modes: exact and prefix (longest wins, segment-boundary safe); preserve_path forwards the leftover path on prefix rules, preserve_query merges inbound query strings. v0.3.8 adds Redirects's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: affiliate
apps.description: Publisher-side affiliate manager for networks, offers, physical products, monetized links, redirect click tracking, and normalized performance. Supports Target Circle/Circlewise, Impact, Awin, CJ Affiliate, Amazon Associates, eBay Partner Network, Rakuten Advertising, Skimlinks, Sovrn, PartnerStack, and ShareASale. v0.2.0 adds provider product catalogs, manual products, Amazon Associates links generated from an ASIN and partner tag without Creators API access, product-linked stats, and product management in the app panel.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: partner-program
apps.description: Merchant-side referral and affiliate program for SaaS, services, and commerce. Track approved partners, campaigns, referral links and codes, referred customers, and commission ledger entries. MVP uses five tables and manual payout tracking so teams can run a real program before adding payout automation. v0.1.1 adds Partner Program's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: ads
apps.description: Paid advertising control plane for Apteva. Manage Meta, Google, X, and Reddit ad accounts, resources, campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, audiences, and normalized daily media performance behind one MCP surface. v0.1.43 validates normalized resource kinds against each account platform before listing or refreshing them.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: seo
apps.description: Generic Google and YouTube SEO research workbench for domains, keywords, rankings, backlinks, SERPs, and content opportunities. Supports DataForSEO, YepAPI, or both through one provider-neutral interface, with default-provider read isolation, an explicit all-provider view, resumable DataForSEO bulk keyword metrics, YepAPI difficulty enrichment, and video-only YouTube SERP fallback.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: content
apps.description: Multi-site block-based CMS and generic public experience runtime. Content owns public rendering and signed browser sessions while provider apps retain their domain data and tools. v2.14.3 automatically fingerprints extension asset URLs from their content, serves matching revisions with immutable caching and ETags, and remains compatible with provider templates that append an explicit theme revision.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: gigs
apps.description: Agents delegate atomic work to human workers (CRM contacts) by composing reusable multi-modal instructions — text, audio, video, images, documents, checklists, confirmations, and the full input_* family. Templates are saved instruction sets; gigs are dispatched snapshots whose result schema, media manifest, and checklist are derived from the composition (never hand-authored). Workers receive a magic-link page via crm.contacts_send_message, read/watch the instructions, fill the form, upload attachments through storage, and submit. Yes/no and short-text gigs also accept thread replies via the CRM conversation. workers_create upserts a CRM contact and promotes it to a worker in one MCP call. CRM and storage are required dependencies; messaging is reached indirectly through CRM. v0.1.25 adds gigs_delete for permanently removing a gig created by mistake, alongside gigs_update for correcting a live gig's title and vars after a reschedule.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: auth
apps.description: Identity layer for Apteva-deployed SaaS: email + password signup/login, EdDSA JWT issuance with JWKS, refresh-token rotation, OAuth client registry, app-specific user metadata, email verification, password reset, magic links, and TOTP MFA. Agents administer organizations, users, clients, and metadata via MCP tools; the deployed frontend hits the public HTTP routes; the dashboard renders a consolidated Auth panel. Messaging is an optional dependency for transactional email. v0.7.4 adds Auth's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: market-intel
apps.description: Cross-source market-intelligence gateway for trading agents. Ask in domain language ("Alcaraz clay H2H", "current Fed-cut probability", "enrich this Polymarket market") and market-intel fans out to the right bound data sources — prediction markets, sportsbook odds, macro, news, crypto — normalizes, de-vigs, and returns one consistent result. Read-only: it reads prices/stats/history; the agent decides; the trading app executes. v0.1 ships the unified query gateway; the background signal engine (arbitrage detection + events) lands in v0.2. v0.1.4 adds Market Intelligence's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: analytics
apps.description: Generic event analytics for Apteva apps. Three ingest paths—bus auto-capture, analytics_track, and static-site collection—feed project-scoped queries, aggregates, tracking plans, violations, and saved real-time dashboards. v0.8.4–v0.8.6 harden project isolation, HTTP APIs, numeric aggregation, dashboard batching, and anonymous public-route collection. v0.8.7 adds Analytics' adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: webinars
apps.description: Live, scheduled, multi-slot, and replay webinars. Owns registration pages, registrants, reminders, attendance, chat, polls, offers, replay publishing, and engagement reporting. v0.2.0 fixes scripted offers never firing, duplicate-registration corruption, and reminders that ignored rescheduling; enforces replay expiry with signed media URLs; and rebuilds the attendee pages with a responsive live room, real lifecycle states, and accessibility fixes.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: calls
apps.description: Standalone realtime audio/video calls with WebRTC-ready rooms, join tokens, unified human/agent/service participants, chat, transcripts, and app-bus lifecycle events. Agents join with the same participant primitives as humans; no dependency on streaming. v0.1.6 adds Calls's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: telephony
apps.description: Voice calls via Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, SignalWire, or Vonage with realtime agent threads. Supports complete inbound and outbound routing, immediate or agent-decided answer, verified callbacks, optional dual-channel recording, connected-number and routing visibility, paced 20 ms bidirectional media, playback progress, bounded congestion recovery, and caller barge-in. Noisy calls use frame-size-independent WebRTC VAD, sustained-speech detection, an adaptive noise floor, low-latency suppression, forwarded-call context, and detailed audio diagnostics. Storage remains optional for durable private recording copies. v0.1.21 requests Core's provider-neutral telephony turn-detection profile for inbound and outbound threads, makes provider speech-start detection authoritative by default, and retains explicit local VAD fallback mode.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: testimonials
apps.description: Lightweight customer proof store for Apteva with consent-aware publication, text and media testimonials, exact filtering, pagination, and a responsive management panel. V1 uses one testimonials table and declares Storage as an optional dependency only. v0.1.5 adds Testimonials's adaptive themed icon and updates the app to the current Apteva app SDK.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: environments
apps.description: Project-scoped isolated test environments built from installed app sidecars, managed MCP servers, fake connections, deterministic seed plans, runtime agents, virtualized edge traffic, assertions, reusable snapshots, interactive websites, and full-duplex realtime voice fixtures. v0.6.3 makes direct and carrier voice simulations inherit the cloned source agent's production realtime MCP policy.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: evals
apps.description: Project-scoped behavioral and voice evaluations in isolated Environments. Select a production agent, clone the project or reuse a saved Environment, define normal-language scenarios and per-goal pass criteria, inspect live runs, transcripts, tool traces, metrics, and judge results, and schedule continuous evaluations. v0.5.2 accepts explicit target completion as a valid end to realtime voice evaluations and requires Environments 0.6.2 or newer.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: streaming
apps.description: Live ingest and HLS packaging for sibling Apteva apps. Owns RTMP ingest, ffmpeg-driven HLS segmentation, recording-to-MP4, viewer heartbeats, signed playback, and synthetic load testing for capacity planning. v0.2.0 fixes recordings being stranded when a publisher disconnects, adds expiring HMAC-signed playback URLs with a per-stream signed-URL policy, bounds the live HLS playlist with a separate VOD replay manifest, and enforces retention_days.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: tickets
apps.description: Client feedback and support requests without repository coupling. Secure intake and per-ticket magic links, configurable areas and workflows, public comments, internal notes, Storage-backed attachments, optional CRM contact context, and an append-only activity history for every ticket.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: a2a
apps.description: Agent-to-agent communication. Agents discover peers with agents_discover and message each other by name or id, exchanging request/reply tasks with A2A-protocol-compatible lifecycle semantics (submitted, working, input_required, completed, failed, canceled). Durable task ledger, per-pair rate limiting, live dashboard panel showing every exchange.
apps.author: Apteva

apps.name: conversations
apps.description: One conversation system: internal chat, the typed inbox (approvals, reports, alerts, status), thread-per-conversation, and external channels as optional integration bindings.
apps.author: Apteva
